board.text: Injury opportunity: Xavier Hutchinson (WR, HOU) steps in for Nico Collins (Out) and nobody has him - proj 6.5, under the radar. 3 free next-men in total.
Woody Marks (BN3, value 5.6/wk) - Upgrade after this week (his best week is now): drop for Ollie Gordon (+3.3/wk)

Waiver: worth a claim - Ollie Gordon (RB, MIA, value 8.9/wk) - Covers an exposed spot - RB has 4.6 starter-week(s) at risk with Woody Marks (5.6) behind them; +3.3/wk over your weakest bench, weighted x1.2; fade risk (67% of seasons like his fall off); last 3 weeks 7.6 ppg; rising; drop Woody Marks (+3.3/wk) (also on 2 rival wish list(s))
Morgan is shopping Alvin Kamara, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Tre Tucker, Tyler Warren: nothing there beats what you would have to give - pass, or wait for the price to drop

Week 5 bye: Harrison Butker (K #20) - replaceable, and worth no more than Dontayvion Wicks. Stream him: claim Spencer Shrader (IND, 10.3/wk) that week in his spot, then take the best free K back in week 6
Week 5 bye: Chiefs D/ST (DST #10) - replaceable, and worth no more than Dontayvion Wicks. Stream him: claim Ravens D/ST (BAL, 6.5/wk) that week in his spot, then take the best free DST back in week 6
Next week: Harrison Butker is on bye - plan the replacement now
Quentin Johnston: 367,591 teams dropped him in the last day (rostered 57%). The crowd is bailing
League rosters are 47 h old - the Yahoo pull did not run

Timing only: Ollie Gordon (RB) is the likely next pickup for PJ, Sophia and he values 3.6/wk above your weakest bench RB - worth claiming on his own merit; the rival interest just argues for doing it sooner
